name: ContextSMS MCP
description:
ContextSMS MCP connects Claude to your ContextSMS SMS business lines. Sign in with your ContextSMS account to work with the phone numbers and conversations your organization has already provisioned in ContextSMS.

What you can do:
• Read SMS threads and list recent conversations for a customer or business line
• Send a single SMS from an authorized ContextSMS line (with built-in rate limits and guardrails)
• Check which business lines and agent context you are authorized to use
• Poll or wait for new inbound customer messages when you need real-time replies

Who it is for:
Teams that use ContextSMS for compliant business SMS and want to summarize threads, draft replies, or send one-off messages from Claude without leaving the chat.

Requirements:
• An active ContextSMS account with at least one authorized business SMS line
• OAuth sign-in through ContextSMS (each user connects their own account)

Data access:
The connector only accesses SMS data and business lines tied to the signed-in ContextSMS user. Messages are not shared across tenants.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ContextSMS MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ContextSMS MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.sabrhub.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ContextSMS MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ContextSMS MCP provides these MCP tools: get_agent_context, get_message_thread, list_conversations, poll_inbound_messages, send_sms, and wait_for_inbound_message.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ContextSMS MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ContextSMS MCP in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.

_published_faq.name: Does ContextSMS MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: ContextSMS MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ContextSMS MCP is developed by Sabrhub Technologies. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
